subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>What is the value of the digit </mtext><mn>4</mn><mtext> in the number </mtext><mn>345</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place value of the digit 4.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: In 345, the digit 4 is in the tens place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: The value of 4 tens is 40.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 40</mtext></mrow></math>

subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>Which number has </mtext><mn>2</mn><mtext> hundreds, </mtext><mn>7</mn><mtext> tens, and </mtext><mn>1</mn><mtext> one?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the value for hundreds: 2 hundreds = 200.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: Identify the value for tens: 7 tens = 70.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Identify the value for ones: 1 one = 1.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 4: Combine the values: 200 + 70 + 1 = 271.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 271</mtext></mrow></math>
